description: This file defines the interface for the RdkPlatformManager's message bus interaction, including function prototypes for engaging with the message bus, initialization, finalization, bus check, and resource freeing. It includes licensing information and macro definitions relevant to message bus component priorities.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Engages or connects to the message bus with specified component ID, configuration file, and path.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the message bus interface with user-specific data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes or cleans up the message bus interface with user-specific data.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a health check or status verification of the message bus.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the message bus, with specified priority and user data.
